$comment: Knobs for the intake pipeline. Edit these; pipeline.py and the RUNBOOK read them.
$execute_mode: to-pr: execute cog runs /worktree-agents to an OPEN PR (never merges). plan-only: dry-run only.
$contract_routing: EP-21 = the rolling intake epic (renamed from EP-INTAKE 2026-07-02 so ids satisfy the planning-worx schema /^(FEAT|EP|TK|TASK)-\d+$/). Intake tickets nest under EP-21 (parent FEAT-3); larger items that warrant their own epic get the next free numeric EP-## assigned at contract-write time, not a semantic name.
$contract_write: autonomous (Jim directive 2026-07-03, supersedes the 2026-06-27 'staged' ruling): PROCESS/decomposition contract writes — ticket splitting, decomposition of already-approved intent, migration mechanics, implementing an architect ruling — are the coordinator's to make and are written WITHOUT a Jim approval gate. Only genuinely new application DIRECTION (a new feature/capability, a priority/vision/non-goal change, a CANON change) still surfaces to Jim before writing. Governance appends (decisions + changelog) remain append-only. A cog must NOT write contract.yaml while another writer has it dirty (concurrency guard).
